full_judgment: 7. Mr. Khan on the other hand submits that an area of 1 acre of land of Plot No. 152 was duly recorded in the name or respondent No.11 Abzan Bibi. Copy of the relevant Khatian has been filed. Mr. Khan accordingly submits that she is a necessary party. He further submits that Abzan Bibi respondent No. 11 has homestead wherein she has been living in the land of Plot No. 152. But her homestead also has been leased out to the writ petitioner by order of the High Court Division as the High Court Division extended previously leased out 4 hectors to 20 hectors without considering the physical possession of the owners in the land.
